data.title: 克莱尔 · 遗迹祭坛前的魔力回溯
data.description: 远古神殿幽暗祭坛前，紫色魔力回路在克莱尔手臂上剧烈闪耀。她单膝跪地手撑地面稳住身形，狂暴魔力气流掀起发丝，目光绝不屈服。
data.location: ancient subterranean ruins altar hall surrounded by cracked stone totems
data.action: kneeling on stone floor with one hand pressed down, purple magical aura flaring along arm, defiant glare through windswept bangs
data.lighting: 魔力紫光冲击波与古殿暗影
data.promptProse: Claire steadies herself on a cracked ruin altar as purple magical energy surges along her arm, glaring defiantly against the storm.
data.animaCaption: Vivid purple magical crests flare across her arm, lighting up the subterranean stones.
